newsitem.title: MEXICO: Pemex details Feb crude, natgas output and trade.
newsitem.headline: Pemex details Feb crude, natgas output and trade.

text.p: Petroleos Mexicanos (Pemex) said it produced 2.968 million barrels per day (bpd) of crude in February compared with 2.844 million bpd the same month the previous year, and 4.331 billion cubic feet per day (cfd) of natural gas versus 4.271 bln cfd a year ago.
The state oil company exported 67.1 million cfd of natural gas compared with 17.1 million cfd in February 1996. Natural gas imports totaled 40.3 million cfd for the month versus 46.9 million cfd.

February's figures show Mexico's highest average daily crude production in at least five years. Pemex produced in February 1.5 million bpd of heavy Maya crude, 886,000 bpd of light Isthmus crude and 582,000 bpd of extra-light Olmeca crude.
Pemex's trading division said on Friday that crude exports were an average 1.567 million bpd in February.

Mexico also narrowed its natural gas import level to register the first net natural gas exports since last May. The nation is aiming to reverse years of being a net importer of the fuel from the United States.

In fuel oil, Pemex said it imported 44,900 bpd and exported 200 bpd. Mexico exported 600 bpd of jet fuel for the month and in liquified petroleum gas (LPG), imported 88,000 bpd and exported 5,000 bpd.
